prompt: Create a transparent-background orthographic atlas in exactly 2 columns by 4 rows. The source references are supplied in row order: (1) necropolis closed doorway, (2) necropolis open doorway, (3) starter closed doorway, (4) starter open doorway. For every row, column 1 is TOP (looking straight down), column 2 is BOTTOM (looking straight up). Each cell contains one isolated horizontal principal view; no perspective. Preserve each row's exact material, arch shape, door state, decoration and opening from its source. TOP of a fixed upright stone doorway must show only the narrow depth footprints: a thin horizontal arch/lintel band, two narrow jamb/column cap strips, and a shallow threshold/door-edge line only when a closed door has one. Do not draw a vertical arch outline, opening, door panel face, or lanterns as frontal faces in the overhead plane. BOTTOM for a CLOSED stone doorway shows the underside of the closed opaque door panel and lintel span connecting the feet, as narrow strips sharing the object's footprint; do not show its upright door face. BOTTOM for an OPEN doorway preserves the open center and shows the overhead arch/lintel soffit as a shallow horizontal stone band connecting jamb-foot underside caps; do not fill the passage or draw a frontal U. Keep world axes consistent and all spans horizontal, with the same material identity as that row's source. No generic wood panels, no extra ornaments, no neighboring objects, no cell crossing. Inferred orthographic views, not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.

reference_inputs.role: canonical source identity, material and open/closed state
canonical source identity, material and open/closed state
canonical source identity, material and open/closed state
canonical source identity, material and open/closed state

constraints: TOP is narrow footprint of upright frame, never frontal arch face
closed BOTTOM includes opaque door and lintel underside
open BOTTOM preserves passage gap plus arch soffit span
internal_qa_failure: The model returned frontal lintel and door ornament faces in the requested plan cells; no candidate directions were normalized or installed.
